identity: owner_epoch u64 + pulse_id u64; duplicate live/held identity rejected

input.power: receive_power_pipeline: six signed IQ16 square/sum values, two registered stages, range 0..2^31
input.sequence: absolute u64 RF sample sequence on every clock, including invalid samples; gap/rollover fails all active contexts
input.noise: six unsigned32 power values frozen at accepted onset; qualification/known flags remain external
input.hold: resolved1..256; config hold0 must be resolved to detector default125 before admission; >256 rejected

causality.required_end: detector body end exclusive; capture stop including POST must not be substituted
causality.late_end: explicit failed result, never revise already committed samples with future knowledge
causality.ram: one shared512-entry delayed POWER/context-quality stream; no captured-IQ A/B port and no bank copy

arithmetic.top_signal: maximum complete four-sample moving average of max(power-frozen_noise,0)
arithmetic.top_rounding: unsigned34 sum divided by4, floor; no partial startup windows
arithmetic.short_body: count<4 implies TOP incomplete; downstream Fine must not qualify it as a complete TOP estimate
arithmetic.p50: frozen_noise + floor(top_signal/2), computed by Fine, no second noise subtraction

result: per-slot immutable until explicit ready; bad/error prevents precision qualification; four retained results stop further admission without stalling ADC
not_yet_proven: Fine TOP consumption and analysis reference lifecycle

binding.core: calibrator_instrument_core enables ONLINE_STATS=1; A-port scan disabled
binding.ownership: atomic onset reservation; exact epoch/pulse query; cancel on retained producer error; results held until qualification admission
binding.pdw: BODY_STATS=1 uses exclusive body count, body peak and energy; RAW header sample_count remains PRE+body+POST
binding.budget_api: cal_capture_budget_plan_online and cal_replay_budgeted_begin_online; max(RAW pending, body_end+275 RF cycles), then caller queue/publish bounds
